tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Window chrome: title bar, side bars (explorer, changes), status bar.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Editor ground: chat thread, code views, diff body, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised inside the editor ground: code block header bars, diff file headers, input box, cards.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Controls at rest: segmented control track, secondary button, tags.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered rows in trees and lists.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The selected/focused row in a tree or list; ink stays on it.

tokens.name: surface-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modal dialogs.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline between panes, rows and cards.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control outlines: inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons (3:1 against their ground).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface token. 10:1 dark, 15:1 light.

tokens.name: ink-strong
tokens.usage: Headings and the active tab label.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: paths after the file name, timestamps, token counts. ≥5.7:1 on all surfaces.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled and excluded items only (exempt from 4.5:1 as inactive UI). Never for readable content.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, checked checkboxes, the active tab underline, focus ring, context bar fill at rest.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (4.5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Links and accent text on any surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 1px outline + 1px offset on keyboard focus.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Added status (A), success toasts, connected state. Text-safe on surfaces.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Context bar 75–94%, changed-on-disk badge, conflict banners. Text-safe on surfaces.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Deleted status (D), context bar ≥95%, destructive actions. Text-safe on surfaces.

tokens.name: modified
tokens.usage: Modified status (M) letter and dot.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Conflict and near-limit banner fill; text on it is ink.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Outline of a warning banner.

tokens.name: diff-add-bg
tokens.usage: Added line background; syntax colors stay on top.

tokens.name: diff-add-word
tokens.usage: Changed characters inside an added line.

tokens.name: diff-add-gutter
tokens.usage: Line-number cells of an added line.

tokens.name: diff-del-bg
tokens.usage: Removed line background.

tokens.name: diff-del-word
tokens.usage: Changed characters inside a removed line.

tokens.name: diff-del-gutter
tokens.usage: Line-number cells of a removed line.

tokens.name: diff-hunk-bg
tokens.usage: Hunk header and 'Expand N lines' rows.

tokens.name: diff-empty-bg
tokens.usage: Filler cell opposite an added/removed line in split view.

tokens.name: editor-line-current
tokens.usage: Current-line band in code views.

tokens.name: editor-gutter-ink
tokens.usage: Line numbers (4.5:1 on surface-100).

tokens.name: editor-gutter-active
tokens.usage: Line number of the current line.

tokens.name: editor-indent-guide
tokens.usage: 1px vertical indentation guides every 4 columns.

tokens.name: editor-selection
tokens.usage: Text selection in code.

tokens.name: pill-bg
tokens.usage: Inline code pill in chat prose.

tokens.name: syn-plain
tokens.usage: Default code text and punctuation.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Declaration keywords: public, class, record, using, var, async, null, true.

tokens.name: syn-control
tokens.usage: Control flow: if, return, await, throw, foreach, switch.

tokens.name: syn-type
tokens.usage: Types, interfaces, attributes: Order, IOrderRepository, Task.

tokens.name: syn-function
tokens.usage: Method and function names at call and declaration.

tokens.name: syn-string
tokens.usage: String and char literals, XML/JSON values.

tokens.name: syn-number
tokens.usage: Numeric literals.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Comments and XML doc comments (4.9:1 dark, 6.1:1 light).

tokens.name: syn-variable
tokens.usage: Locals, parameters, properties, JSON keys, XML attributes.

tokens.name: syn-tag
tokens.usage: XML/HTML tag names.

tokens.name: syn-heading
tokens.usage: Markdown headings, YAML keys.
